name: ninjamuffin99/canabalt-hf
license: MIT (code, Finji 2024); assets All Rights Reserved
embed_notes: Official Finji-sanctioned port of the 2009 Flash original. `lime test html5` produces a static bundle. Requires Haxe 4.3.3 + hmm; assets are a git submodule (canabalt-assets) that is All Rights Reserved and must be replaced.
reskin_notes: Code is MIT so modification/commercial use is fine, but the 'Canabalt' trademark, art and Danny Baranowsky music are reserved: a reskin must replace every asset and ship under a different name. Assets are plain PNG/MP3 so the swap is mechanical.
score_hook: Distance counter in PlayState; game already integrates Newgrounds.io leaderboards (medals/scoreboards) - replace that client with your own scoring endpoint.
notes: Ported by Cameron 'ninjamuffin99' Taylor; README says code is as close to Adam Saltsman's original AS3 as possible for 1:1 gameplay.

name: AdamAtomic/Mode
embed_notes: AS3 source: compile to SWF with Flex/AIR SDK then run under Ruffle; simpler to use the HaxeFlixel port in HaxeFlixel/flixel-demos (Platformers/Mode) and target HTML5.
reskin_notes: Tiny embedded PNG sprites and a tilemap; trivial to replace. No trademark concerns.
score_hook: Score/kills tracked in PlayState; add ExternalInterface.call in AS3 or postMessage in the Haxe port.
notes: Canonical flixel demo game by Adam Saltsman (2009). license.txt is MIT text.

name: AdamAtomic/EZPlatformer
embed_notes: Same as Mode; HaxeFlixel port exists in flixel-demos/Platformers/EZPlatformer.
reskin_notes: Single-screen coin-collect platformer with a handful of sprites.
notes: MIT license.txt verified.

name: AdamAtomic/Flx-Invaders
embed_notes: HaxeFlixel port in flixel-demos/Arcade/FlxInvaders targets HTML5.
reskin_notes: Space Invaders-like; sprites are tiny PNGs.
notes: MIT license.txt verified.

name: AdamAtomic/FlxTeroids
embed_notes: HaxeFlixel port in flixel-demos/Arcade/FlxTeroids.
reskin_notes: Asteroids-like.
notes: MIT license.txt verified.

name: AdamAtomic/Bomber-Planet
embed_notes: AS3 only; no Haxe port known. Compile + Ruffle.
reskin_notes: Top-down action-adventure, more assets than the other demos.
notes: Author calls it 'sloppy' source. MIT license.txt verified.

name: AdamAtomic/Flappybalt
embed_notes: HaxeFlixel port in flixel-demos/Arcade/Flappybalt targets HTML5.
reskin_notes: Flappy-like with Canabalt-themed art; replace art (Canabalt trademark).
notes: Flappy Jam 2014 entry by Adam Saltsman.

name: HaxeFlixel/flixel-demos
embed_notes: Each demo is a Lime project: `lime test html5` yields a static folder. LICENSE.md is MIT (2013).
reskin_notes: Small pixel-art assets in each demo's assets folder.
score_hook: Per-game score vars; HaxeFlixel can call JS via js.Browser / externs.
notes: Maintained HTML5-ready ports of the Flixel-era demo games.

name: AdamAtomic/flixel
embed_notes: The AS3 engine behind Canabalt, Gravity Hook, Fathom. Runs under Ruffle once compiled.
reskin_notes: Engine, not a game.
notes: Historic Flash-era engine; use HaxeFlixel for new builds.

name: gabrielecirulli/2048
embed_notes: Pure static HTML/CSS/JS; drop in an iframe or inline.
reskin_notes: Tiles are CSS; swap colors/logo/mascot images in minutes.
score_hook: GameManager.score; HTMLActuator receives {score, over, won} each move - emit postMessage on game over. Deterministic given seed+inputs, so server replay is feasible.
notes: The actual original 2048 (2014).

name: wayou/t-rex-runner
embed_notes: Single sprite sheet + index.js; static.
reskin_notes: One sprite sheet (dino, cacti, clouds) - replace dino with mascot.
notes: Code extracted from Chromium (BSD).

name: BKcore/HexGL
embed_notes: Static; heavy 3D assets, WebGL required.
reskin_notes: Ship model/textures replaceable; mascot as ship decal or hologram.
score_hook: Lap/race time in gameplay controller; no native leaderboard.
notes: 2012 WebGL racer by Thibaut Despoulain.

name: MaxBittker/sandspiel
embed_notes: wasm-pack + webpack build; upload/browse features use Firebase (strip or replace).
reskin_notes: UI/palette reskin easy; no characters. Sandbox, no win state.
notes: Modern open-source successor to Falling Sand/Powder Game.

name: ncase/nothing-to-hide
embed_notes: Static JS; some levels/assets unfinished ('not clean, not organized, but everything').
reskin_notes: Public domain art/code; mascot could replace the protagonist sprite.
score_hook: Level completion/time; no score system built in.
notes: Nicky Case's 2014 open-source stealth game.

name: ncase/wbwwb
embed_notes: Static PIXI build.
reskin_notes: Narrative/satire game; reskin possible but tone-sensitive.
notes: Uses CC-licensed freesound audio - keep attributions.

name: ncase/trust
embed_notes: Static.
reskin_notes: Interactive explainer, not an arcade game.
notes: Included for completeness of the Nicky Case CC0 set (also ncase/anxiety, 496 stars, CC0).

name: nebez/floppybird
embed_notes: Static HTML/CSS/JS.
reskin_notes: Art imitates Flappy Bird (Gears/dotGears trademark) - replace bird and pipes with mascot art.
notes: Clone, not the original; original Flappy Bird is proprietary.

name: ellisonleao/clumsy-bird
embed_notes: Static melonJS build; archived 2018.
reskin_notes: GPL: publish your modified source. Art must be replaced (Flappy lookalike).
notes: Archived repo.

name: daleharvey/pacman
embed_notes: Single-file static.
reskin_notes: Pac-Man is a Bandai Namco trademark and the ghosts/maze are protected trade dress - must fully re-theme (mascot maze game).
score_hook: User score var in pacman.js; hook on level/die.

name: Hextris/hextris
embed_notes: Static; hextris.io.
reskin_notes: Colors/UI trivially themed; GPL requires publishing modified source.
score_hook: Global `score` in main.js; gameOver path in checkGameOver().
notes: 2014 original by Logan Engstrom et al.

name: candybox2/candybox2
license: GPL-3.0 (license header in candybox2_sourceCodeLicense.txt; not auto-detected)
embed_notes: tsc compile then static host (compile.sh).
reskin_notes: ASCII-art idle/RPG; branding limited to text/colors.
score_hook: Candies count / quest progress; no leaderboard.
notes: Candy Box 1 repo candybox2/candybox (244 stars) has no license file.

name: doublespeakgames/adarkroom
embed_notes: Static.
reskin_notes: Text-only; sponsor branding awkward. MPL file-level copyleft only.
notes: Web version open; iOS version is commercial/closed.

name: lostdecade/onslaught_arena
license: GPL (README; no LICENSE file); assets free to redistribute, not resell
embed_notes: htdocs folder is static.
reskin_notes: Pixel sprites replaceable; assets cannot be resold without permission.
score_hook: Score/wave counters in engine; Chrome Web Store leaderboard code present.
notes: 2010 HTML5 arcade shooter by Lost Decade Games.

name: mozilla/BrowserQuest
embed_notes: Needs a node game server; archived 2023 (see fork browserquest/BrowserQuest, 465 stars).
reskin_notes: Tilesets/sprites replaceable; CC-BY-SA art must stay share-alike if reused.
score_hook: Achievements/kills exist server-side - easy to expose.
notes: 2012 Mozilla HTML5 MMO demo.

name: increpare/PuzzleScript
embed_notes: Exports self-contained HTML per game.
reskin_notes: Sprites are 5x5 text legends; each community game carries its own author license.
score_hook: Level completion; add via export template.
notes: Stephen Lavelle's engine; thousands of tiny puzzle games.

name: freeciv/freeciv-web
embed_notes: Java/Tomcat + C server + DB; heavy.
reskin_notes: AGPL: any modified hosted version must publish full source.
score_hook: In-game score exists; long-form strategy, poor fit for P2E.

name: cloudflare/doom-wasm
embed_notes: emscripten build -> static wasm + JS; needs an IWAD - use Freedoom (BSD). id-Software/DOOM (19,456 stars, GPL-2.0) is the upstream release.
reskin_notes: Doom name/assets are Bethesda's; Freedoom + PWAD sprite replacement is a mature modding pipeline.
score_hook: No JS hook; add EM_ASM calls at level end / kill counters.

name: inolen/quakejs
license: MIT per README (engine derived from ioquake3 GPL-2.0 - treat as GPL)
embed_notes: Node content server + dedicated server for multiplayer; needs Quake 3 data (proprietary) or OpenArena (GPL).
reskin_notes: Quake trademark; asset packs are the whole game.

name: SuperTux/supertux
embed_notes: Official WASM build since 0.6.3; playable at play.supertux.org. Large download.
reskin_notes: Replacing Tux with a mascot means redoing full sprite sheets; GPL publish requirement.
score_hook: Coins/score/time in-game; no JS bridge - add via emscripten.

name: The-Powder-Toy/The-Powder-Toy
embed_notes: wasm32-emscripten target in CI/meson; needs threads -> COOP/COEP headers for SharedArrayBuffer.
reskin_notes: Sandbox; no characters, no score.
notes: GPL cousin of Dan-Ball's proprietary Powder Game.

name: nxengine/nxengine-evo
embed_notes: No official web build; SDL2 -> emscripten is plausible. Needs Cave Story freeware data files, which are Studio Pixel's copyright (freeware, not open).
reskin_notes: Data files not licensed for modification.

name: caiiiycuk/js-dos
embed_notes: DOSBox in the browser for DOS-era shareware (Doom, Commander Keen shareware episodes etc.).
reskin_notes: Emulator; games inside keep their own licenses.
notes: Not Flash, but the equivalent 'emulate the original' path for DOS.

name: kevansevans/OpenLR
embed_notes: Haxe with a JavaScript target ('For the JavaScript target, hlsdl and hlopenal is not needed'). Immature.
reskin_notes: 'Line Rider' name/character are proprietary (rights sold to inXile 2007); sled rider sprite replaceable with mascot.
score_hook: None; Line Rider is a sandbox.
notes: jealouscloud/linerider-advanced (54 stars, GPL-3.0) and RatherBeLunar/LRA-Community-Edition (11 stars, GPL-3.0) are C# desktop apps, not embeddable; conundrumer/lr-core (28 stars) has no license.

name: jealouscloud/linerider-advanced
embed_notes: Desktop only (Windows/Linux/Mac). Not web-embeddable without a rewrite.
reskin_notes: Desktop; trademark issues as above.
notes: 'Open source spiritual successor to the flash game Line Rider 6.2'.

name: TerryCavanagh/VVVVVV
license: VVVVVV Source Code License v1.0 (source-available; personal compile only; redistribution needs permission; no art/music)
embed_notes: No official web build; SDL2 could be emscripten-built but the license forbids distributing it commercially.
reskin_notes: Not permitted without a separate license from Terry Cavanagh.
notes: Included because it is the highest-profile Flash-era game with public source; it is NOT open source.

name: TylerGlaiel/GlaielGamesOldFlashSources
embed_notes: Open .fla in Flash CS6 (AS2) / Animate, publish SWF, serve via Ruffle. Large FLAs are in Releases.
reskin_notes: Non-commercial + share-alike: 'use these for preservation and educational purposes only'. Would need a separate deal with Glaiel.
notes: Aether and AVGM excluded (sold in The Basement Collection).

name: ericjohnson/canabalt-ios
license: Custom 'Canabalt Game License' - proprietary except the flixel-ios folder
embed_notes: iOS project; not web.
reskin_notes: GAME_LICENSE.TXT: all source outside flixel-ios is 'Content' and may not be distributed. Use ninjamuffin99/canabalt-hf (MIT) instead.
notes: Often mis-cited as 'Canabalt open source'.

name: nuclear-unicorn/kittensgame
license: WET PAWS LICENSE (no commercial use, no derivative works)
embed_notes: Static, but license forbids derivatives/commercial use.
reskin_notes: Forbidden by license.

name: ozh/cookieclicker
license: none (unauthorized mirror of Orteil's proprietary Cookie Clicker)
embed_notes: Do not use.
reskin_notes: Proprietary.
notes: Listed to answer 'is Cookie Clicker open source' - no. Same for jgmize/paperclips (112 stars, Universal Paperclips mirror, no license).

name: OgarProject/Ogar
embed_notes: Server only; the agar.io client is proprietary, so you would need your own client.
reskin_notes: Agar.io name/client are Miniclip's.
notes: Archived 2020; forks (MultiOgar etc.) vary in license.
